propositions: Close of task/story/epic must not proceed if the plan or upstream pinned plan changed during execution, without re-running review or invalidating implementations for code drift alone.
The close-time gate validates signature, registry currency, own-material drift, phase compatibility, and configured pin enforcement while intentionally skipping code freshness checks.
The gate runs as a pre-status-check callback inside the existing write lock after structural checks but before STATUS append, catching race conditions between precheck and append.
A failing gate blocks close with a structured verdict-prefixed error message and directs the user to run review-plan separately, never launching review itself.
Enforcement is opt-in via require_plan_review_for_close config flag and preserves all existing exemptions (bugs, session logs, code reviews, identities, idea→closed) and force-close bypass behavior.
The implementation performs zero LLM, model, or network calls; all validity checks are local reads of signatures, metadata, and registry state.
